design_description: A clean red jersey inspired by classic Swiss sporting colours. The body is kept almost completely solid red, creating a simple, disciplined look with black shoulder panels, black crew collar and black sleeve cuffs providing contrast. The front uses a white Swiss cross opposite the team crest, with a compact white number centred below. A small mountain-line graphic on the sleeve adds a subtle Tahoe reference without disrupting the minimal design. The back remains equally clean, featuring a large white number, a small mountain motif below the collar, and Tahoe Ski Patrol branding near the lower back. Overall, it's minimal, functional and immediately recognizable, with the red/white/black palette doing most of the work.
